pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Wideband airborne radio direction finder, the CAP fleet replacement for the Becker SAR-DF 517. Full 406 MHz channel coverage, receiver audio, DF and FRQ pages, dual-function softkeys and auto-squelch. Driven by the same cap/df/* engine datarefs as the 517 so the two heads can be flown side by side.
